claim: For a finite Gibbs CE family, real coefficients, and one Fréchet-induced direction, the coefficient-weighted pairwise centered-BKM quadratic equals both the dissipative form of the finite Gibbs CE Onsager system for the weighted aggregate observable and, under self-adjointness of that aggregate CE readout, its real Gibbs log-partition Hessian. The same quadratic is nonnegative.

carrier.type: Finite family Fin m → GibbsOperator n, actual CE one-form readouts on Carrier n = (realDerivationsLane (GibbsOperator n)).L, and the existing finite Gibbs CE OnsagerCasimirSystem
operations: real coefficient-weighted sum of Gibbs observables and CE readouts
pairwise centered finite BKM covariance quadratic
finite Gibbs CE Onsager dissipative bilinear form
real second Fréchet variation of the additive Gibbs log-partition
conventions: the aggregate observable is ∑ i, c i • a i
the pairwise quadratic uses ∑ i, c i • ∑ j, c j • Cov_BKM(a_i(D), a_j(D))
the self-adjointness assumption is on the actual aggregate CE readout at the chosen direction
this is finite-dimensional and makes no cross-index single-observable identification beyond the proved weighted aggregate

    (∑ i, c i • ∑ j, c j •

      centeredBKMRealCovariance (faithfulGibbsDensity H hH hZ)
        (continuous_faithfulGibbsDensity_rpow H hH hZ)

          (finiteCEFrechetDirection D))
        (∑ i, c i • finiteCEOperatorForm n (a i)
          (finiteCEFrechetDirection D)) ∧
    0 ≤ ∑ i, c i • ∑ j, c j •
      centeredBKMRealCovariance (faithfulGibbsDensity H hH hZ)
        (continuous_faithfulGibbsDensity_rpow H hH hZ)
        (finiteCEOperatorForm n (a i) (finiteCEFrechetDirection D))
        (finiteCEOperatorForm n (a j) (finiteCEFrechetDirection D)) := by

smallest_gap.description: Reuse the proved pairwise BKM expansion, identify the aggregate readout with the CE differential of the weighted observable by a full finite-sum linearity theorem, and apply the existing Gibbs Onsager/Hessian identity under self-adjointness of that aggregate readout.

out_of_scope: Off-diagonal family-index Hessian identification with a single-observable Onsager system
Time-reversal parity reciprocity or nonvanishing curvature
Infinite-dimensional or universal colimit Gibbs/Onsager results
